summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by ensuring that the iterable class is set to ValuesIterable when values_select is True, preventing the creation of model instances instead of dictionaries.

issues.description: The change may introduce behavioral regression risk if there are other scenarios where the iterable class needs to be set differently based on the query configuration.
The patch could benefit from additional comments explaining why setting the iterable class to ValuesIterable is necessary in this context.
